title: Writing / Tone
slide_intent: Adjust emotional delivery to the audience’s situation so a recognizable voice remains empathetic.
strategic_value: A stable voice with flexible tone can help Duolingo handle celebration and difficulty without sounding inconsistent.
demonstration: The blue header pairs tone guidance with an illustration of a violin, grand piano and flute.
practical_value: Assess the audience’s likely state of mind before choosing the degree of excitement or reassurance.

content_islands.name: Section introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the Writing label, lowercase section title and explanatory paragraph at left on the blue field.

content_islands.name: Illustrated cue
content_islands.spec: Group the contrasting musical instruments on the right of the blue field.

reference_purposes.Intent: The paragraph tells writers to consider audience feeling, adapt with empathy and remain clear, human and relaxed.
reference_purposes.Expression: The blue header pairs tone guidance with a violin, keyboard and flute-like instrument illustration.
